notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo + changes
notes.notes:
Hello (≧∇≦)ﾉ
I'm Krystian also known as "Felt", sole creator of Rock 'n' Bones

The time for Steam Next Fest has finally come, and you can play my demo today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091667/bd643a73c2c7bb3cf7c2b28ce6db7ff14c4aad05.gif[/img]

This game is a 2D platformer where you can't jump, instead you move up by throwing your head and teleporting to it.
It is supposed to be kind of hard but not rage level hard like for example Jump King.

The demo was available a bit before the Steam Next Fest but I made some changes for it like a new opening cutscene with more lore and making some places easier (plus other small changes and bug fixes).

It would be a great help if you could wishlist my game and I hope that whether you have positive or negative feedback, you will share it so that you and I can enjoy a better game in the future. (❁´◡`❁)!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2762080/Rock_n_Bones/
